title: Chicken With Broccoli Stir Fry
content:
Title: Chicken With Broccoli Stir Fry
Category: Chicken
Keywords: Poultry; Vegetable; Meat; High Protein; Healthy; High In...; < 30 Mins; Easy
Description: Make and share this Chicken With Broccoli Stir Fry recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: cornstarch; water; garlic powder; boneless skinless chicken breasts; broccoli florets; soy sauce; brown sugar; ground ginger
Instructions: Combine 2 tbsp cornstarch, 2 tbsp water and garlic powder in a bowl and mix until smooth. Add chicken and toss until well coated. Stir-fry chicken in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat in 1 tbsp oil until meat is no longer pink, about 10 minutes. Remove meat from skillet and keep warm. Stir-fry broccoli in the remaining oil for about 5 minutes, then return chicken to pan. Mix together soy sauce, brown sugar, ginger and remaining 1 tbsp of cornstarch and 1/2 cup water until smooth; add soy mixture to skillet. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Serve over rice.

title: Almond Chicken and Rice
content:
Title: Almond Chicken and Rice
Category: One Dish Meal
Keywords: Chicken Breast; Chicken; Brown Rice; White Rice; Poultry; Rice; Meat; Healthy; < 30 Mins; Stove Top
Description: This was in the latest Kraft Foods recipe magazine. I am looking for gluten free, dairy free, garlic and onion free recipes and this was pretty close. I just added salt and left out the garlic powder. I also used precooked brown rice. I had cooked 2 dry cups of rice and added it all in with the broth. Turned out pretty good. I had never thought of browning chicken with Italian dressing! Plus, I just used regular Italian dressing.
Ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breast; fat-free chicken broth; garlic powder; broccoli florets
Instructions: Cook chicken in 2 T dressing in large nonstick skillet on medium heat, 4 minutes on each side or until evenly browned. Stir in broth, garlic, and remaining dressing; bring to boil. Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until chicken is done. Remove chicken and keep warm. Add broccoli to skillet; cook, uncovered, 3 minutes. Stir in rice and 3 T nuts. Remove from heat, cover and let stand 7 minutes. Serve chicken over the rice mixture; top with remaining nuts.

title: Sesame Chicken
content:
Title: Sesame Chicken
Category: Brown Rice
Keywords: Poultry; Rice; Vegetable; Meat; < 30 Mins
Description: Make and share this Sesame Chicken recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: soy sauce; cooking wine; water; water; cornstarch; sugar; soy sauce; minced garlic cloves; chicken breasts; broccoli; long grain brown rice
Instructions: Cut chicken into small strips and place in marinade. Cook the rice using 2 parts water to 1 part rice in double boiler. Heat pan over medium high heat and add a small amount of oil. Stir fry the chicken to fully cook. Add broccoli followed by sauce mix and place a lid on pan to steam broccoli. Serve over rice and garnish with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Teriyaki Chicken & Edamame Rice Bowls
content:
Title: Teriyaki Chicken & Edamame Rice Bowls
Category: One Dish Meal
Keywords: Chicken Breast; Chicken; Brown Rice; Poultry; Rice; Meat; Healthy; < 60 Mins; Easy
Description: Make and share this Teriyaki Chicken & Edamame Rice Bowls recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts; edamame; red bell peppers; yellow bell pepper; brown rice; long grain brown rice; fresh cilantro leaves
Instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly brown and cooked through. Stir in edamame, bell pepper and teriyaki sauce. Bring to boil and cook, stirring constantly, for 30 seconds. Add rice and cilantro, stir until well combined and heated through.

title: Chicken and Brown Rice Pilaf
content:
Title: Chicken and Brown Rice Pilaf
Category: Chicken Breast
Keywords: Chicken; Brown Rice; Poultry; Rice; Meat; < 30 Mins; Easy
Description: I got this recipe from a magazine at work. This is a pretty easy to put together recipe that you could customize to fit your own likes.
Ingredients: bacon; chicken breasts; onion; sugar snap pea; water; cooked brown rice; parmesan cheese; fresh parsley
Instructions: Cook bacon and drain. Cook chicken and keep warm. You could use leftover reheated chicken for this if you wanted. Saute onions and peppers for 3 minutes. Stir in peas and water. Cover and simmer 4-5 minutes or til peas are tender crisp. Stir in rice.
